sn52.3:2.8: The exact sense of “lower”, “middle”, and “higher” _dhammas_ here is unclear.  Given the context of Anuruddha’s psychic powers, I follow Bodhi’s suggestion that we interpret in line with [an3.76](), understanding _dhamma_ . The commentary, alternatively, cites the Abhidhamma Dhammasaṅgaṇī ([ds1.1:40.1]()), which has the three as one of its triads in the sense of good, mundane wholesome, and transcendent mental qualities. This analysis, however, does not really reflect Sutta usage, which typically speaks of simply lower and higher _dhammas_ ([sn46.2:10.2]()). Moreover, we would expect a plural in that case.
